landing.eyebrow: Full-stack pet project · Java · Spring Boot · React
landing.heroLead: Alijenta is a task management app with a Kanban board, role-based access and dynamic search. Every task can be sent to Telegram, Email or Google Calendar, and files live in Dropbox.
landing.demoNote: Demo account included, no registration needed.
landing.featuresLead: Everything below is backed by a real Spring Boot REST API.

board.title: Kanban board & smart search
board.text: Filter tasks by title, status, priority, assignee, project, dates and attachments, built on the Specification pattern.

security.title: Roles & JWT security
security.text: Stateless JWT authentication with USER and ADMIN roles and method-level access rules.

telegram.title: Telegram notifications
telegram.text: Send a task straight to the assignee through a Telegram bot linked to their chat.

email.title: Email notifications
email.text: SMTP delivery with user credentials stored encrypted, never in plain text.

calendar.title: Google Calendar sync
calendar.text: Connect your calendar with OAuth2 and turn any task into a calendar event.

dropbox.title: Dropbox attachments
dropbox.text: Upload files to tasks and download them later, stored in Dropbox.

landing.howLead: Event-driven and asynchronous: the HTTP request never waits for Telegram, SMTP or Google.

step1.title: Action in the UI
step1.text: You press “Send to Telegram” on a task.

step2.title: Event published
step2.text: The service publishes a domain event and returns at once.

step3.title: Async listener
step3.text: A listener picks the event up on a separate thread pool.

step4.title: Delivered
step4.text: Telegram, Email or Google Calendar receives the task.
